def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    fits = remaining >= 0
    
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    if not np.any(fits):
        return priority_scores
    
    # Component 1: Tightness of fit (higher for smaller remaining capacity)
    tightness = np.zeros_like(bins)
    tightness[fits] = 1 / (remaining[fits] + 1)
    
    # Component 2: Balance after insertion (higher when resulting capacity is closer to mean)
    new_capacities = bins.copy()
    new_capacities[fits] = remaining[fits]
    mean_capacity = np.mean(new_capacities[fits])
    balance = np.zeros_like(bins)
    balance[fits] = 1 / (np.abs(new_capacities[fits] - mean_capacity) + 1)
    
    # Weighted combination favoring tightness slightly more
    priority_scores[fits] = 0.6 * tightness[fits] + 0.4 * balance[fits]
    
    return priority_scores
